blocks.title: Detention tanks for school sites.
blocks.body:
Many school additions and site upgrades now need onsite stormwater detention. Our crews excavate for the tank, install it, set flow control manholes and connect the storm system.

At Guildford Park Secondary in Surrey we built a large stormwater detention tank with flow control manholes as part of the full civil scope. At Brighouse Elementary in Richmond we installed a new detention tank and flow control manholes with the storm and sanitary upgrade.

items.q: Do you build stormwater detention tanks?
items.a: Yes. We built detention tanks with flow control manholes at Guildford Park Secondary in Surrey and Brighouse Elementary in Richmond.

items.q: Can you do the full civil scope around the tank?
items.a: Yes. At Guildford Park we delivered the whole civil package, from bulk excavation and the detention tank to sewer and water upgrades and frontage works.
